image_description: Three disposable-style lighters arranged in a row against a white background. The left lighter is lit with a small flame, featuring a purple top and a blue body with a feather design. The middle lighter is unlit, showing the metal wind guard and spark mechanism clearly, with a similar feather design on a teal/blue gradient body. The right lighter is closed with a solid purple cap and body, appearing simpler. All objects cast soft reflections on the surface below.
